{{Quote|Beyond this door lies the Holocron Vault. The Holocrons contain the most closely guarded secrets of the Jedi Order.|Master [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="hh" />}}
The '''Holocron Vault''' was a secured chamber located in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] deep within the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. It was within these chambers that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] stored its [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], in addition to the [[Holocron Chamber|Vault]] in the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]].

==History==
[[File:YodaHolocronChamber-HH.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] stands at the vault's entrance]]
The Holocron Vault, along with the vaults in the First Knowledge Tower, held the Order's holocron's under the watchful eye of the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Chief Librarian]].<ref name="hh" /> Although only Jedi Masters were supposed to access [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]], there was little in the way of security on them. This changed following the incident of the theft of such a holocron by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Lorian Nod]]. After this incident, known as the "Lorian Nod affair," any holocrons containing the deepest secrets of Masters of the Force were guarded in such as way that they could only be accessed by Jedi Masters.<ref name="Legacy of the Jedi">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref><ref name="Episode III Novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], to infiltrate the Temple's holocron vault in the Fourth Hall of the Archives and steal a holocron. Having killed Jedi [[Ord Enisence/Legends|Ord Enisence]], Bane hired [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] bounty hunter [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] to assume the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] Jedi's form. Equipped with schematics of the Temple by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], Parasitti, in the form of Master Enisence, entered the Temple Archives in order to guide Bane through the ventilation shaft. While the Jedi noticed the break in, they failed to guess where the intruder was headed. Distracted, the Jedi rushed around the Temple while Bane slipped into the vault without disturbance. Stealing the artifact he was hired to acquire, he calmly exited the Temple in a stolen Jedi robe; Parasitti meanwhile was detained by the Jedi, having been left behind by Bane.<ref name="hh" /><ref name="TJP" />

==Layout==
[[File:Archives_map_TJP.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Floor plan of the Archives and Vaults found in ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.]]
{{Quote|Can we go inside?"<br />"Oh I'm afraid not, my dear. I haven't been inside myself for years. Only members of the Jedi Council are allowed access.|Ahsoka Tano asking Jocastu Nu about entering the Holocron Vault|<ref name="hh" />}}
Located along the outer edges of both the Second and Fourth Halls of the Archives, the four Vaults were protected behind a set of two dilating security doors. Between the two portals was a circular hallway filled with security lasers capable of detecting movement and sounding alarms. Only accessible by the twelve [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] with seats on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] or the five of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]], entrance to the chamber was controlled by a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-activated lock.<ref name="hh" /> In addition to the outer entrances each pair of Vaults was connected by another laser-crossed hallway.<ref name="TJP" />

Beyond the security hall, a circular chamber was lit with the faint blue glow from the resting holocrons. Stored in dilating niches in the wall, there was also a pillar in the center of the room, filled with the palm-sized artifacts.<ref name="hh" />
